headline_result: Balanced physical splits of an exact two-sided carrier-aligned rank-two packet satisfy E3(B)>=g^6 E3(Mcar)>=g^6|det S|^2 s3(Mcar)^2. Thus any genuine third four-mode carrier direction is paid by the completed physical-E3 receiver with a continuous C0 density; failure is exactly a Schur-rigid rank-two four-mode carrier K=S^T H^{-1}S.
assigned_time_result: On the paid branch, int |t|^{-1/2}|phi_Q(t)|^2 dt <=4 sqrt(pi C_E3) g^{-1/2}|det S|^{-1/6}s3(Mcar)^{-1/6}, using the independent-copy identity only for the whole scalar output.
robust_tail_result: If the actual literal cross block is ideal carrier plus deterministic coefficient error E with ||E||op<=epsilon, then s_j(B)>=[g s_j(Mcar)-epsilon]_+ for j=1,2,3 and E3(B)>=prod_j[g s_j(Mcar)-epsilon]_+^2. No random coefficient tail is discarded.
